diagram_notes.content:
**[KIT] 00 · Launch Storyworks** — Mode badge: **none** (no MCP surface; the AI Agent actions are tool-less, except the one-tool provider probe, which is a check and not a runtime tool path).

**Purpose.** Provision the Storyworks from one kickoff Page (section A, with the provider probe in F); mirror the tracker from git into Records (B); let people add use cases and decide the Tines-side gates G0, G6, G7, GX and unpark (C); run the tool-less brief_writer, planner and retro_writer on state changes, behind a kill switch and daily caps (D); and let the repository pull Tines-side changes as tracker PRs (E).

**Entry points.** A: the root Page kickoff (+ dev-only Webhook kickoff_test) · B: Webhook tracker_sync_in (Secret) · C: the root Page tracker_home + three App endpoint Webhooks (app_add_use_case, app_gate_decision, app_costs) · D: the schedule dispatch_sweep (*/15, watchdog 1800 s) + dev-only Webhook specialist_test · E: the response-enabled Webhook tracker_outbox (Secret).

**Outputs.** A private repository with the tenant config and setup-report commits; Skills, three Record types, the kit Resources, tracker Records; a Dashboard and an App when entitled; proposals for people. Never writes to GitHub after day 1. Credentials by name: tines_api_kit, github_factory (section A only), tines_api_readonly, slack_bot (optional).

**Design:** stories/kit-launch/DESIGN.md and sections/*.md.
